metadataRaw.title: Relieve Stiff Hips in Seconds #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that can quickly improve pain-free range of motion in the hips.

This exercise will focus on lengthening and strengthening muscles that help support the hip, including the glutes. It's perfect to use throughout the day to release stiffness and tightness in (and around) the hips. 

It can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may give hip pain relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
